description: AirRun: prepare (unsigned) one player step of an Air Run. action: approve_leader (allow a pilot to put you in their squad; `leader`, `approved`), enter (APPLY for an open run during its application window with a helicopter or private jet you own; `runId`, `aircraftId`, optional `members` (you first, then a Hacker role 2 and/or Inside Agent role 5, each of whom called approve_leader for you) with `roles` (1 for you), optional `minOddsBps`; needs a valid Air licence; everyone who applies is equal, the odds are fixed now; no payment), advance (`runId`; anyone, after the window: no applicant = the run expires, one = takes the seat, several = a drand lottery picks exactly one; call it again once the seat round is out), resolve (`runId`; anyone, after the flight's own drand round), void (`runId`; anyone, a seat draw or flight stalled for 6 hours; nobody loses anything), claim (collect your winnings).

action.description: approve_leader, enter, advance, resolve, void or claim.

aircraftId.description: For enter: your vehicle token id.

members.description: For enter: wallets, you first (1 to 3).

minOddsBps.description: For enter: refuse if the odds come out lower (0 = no check).

roles.description: For enter: one role per member, you = 1 (Pilot), others 2 (Hacker) or 5 (Inside Agent).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_air_run
